▶ Background


Orange Room started as a visual experiment for Layer Eleven — a space to explore how structure, motion, and contrast could speak without words. The brief was intentionally abstract. The execution had to be precise. Built from scratch with a custom scroll system, layered transitions, and a minimalist grid, the site blends cinematic visuals with frontend discipline.

▶ Client Review


Working with Julián felt more like teaming up with a creative partner than hiring a developer. From the first conversation, he understood the energy and mood we were aiming for. He asked the right questions, explored visual directions with intent, and delivered a build that felt as thoughtful as it was bold.


Every detail, from scroll behavior to motion timing was carefully considered. Julián brought clarity to a concept that had only lived in loose sketches and moodboards. He helped us tell a story through interface and interaction. The result is something that not only represents who we are, but inspires how we build from here.
